intelligence.human_view: Think of the calendar as a book of days, and you are reading it one slide at a time. Keep reading is your bookmark — it moves you forward, and it never drops you back at the start of the chapter. Flip from Monday to Tuesday and you land on the same page you were reading, on the new day. The notifications page is five tidy boxes, each with one name and one big number in the middle — no name written twice, no number shown twice. The world clock opens into a whole panel, not a little pop-up, and you pick your city from a list, because no handful of buttons covers where everyone is from. The wisdom slide is bigger now, its name at the top, the glowing orb below it, a greeting that knows whether it is morning or afternoon, and the quote underneath — and it moves, it does not sit still. The buttons at the bottom are lifted up so the frame never cuts them off, and the little dots that tell you where you are sit in the top-right corner, where they belong. The cover picture is no longer a page you have to flip past — it is the background behind the day, giving the day its feeling. And behind all of this, the machine has its own rhythm: a note filed is a note on the Hub, straight away; the Hub gets finished before anything is copied from it; and every finished piece is checked by the captain and handed to Shawn at once, nothing held back for a roundup. The avatar's movement, meanwhile, is not something a new outfit can fix — the picture comes through fine, the motion does not follow, and that is the platform's to answer.

intelligence.naya_view: Keep reading carries the slide: forward through the day's slides, never back to the beginning; day-to-day lands on the SAME slide on the new day. Notifications: five blocks, one label on top, one big number centred, one number per block, numbers real, zero where empty; Naya Notes and Smart Notes combine under Personal as one total. World clock opens into a full inner panel — drop-down city/timezone, no flat buttons, Close pops, everything pro level. Wisdom slide: label first at the very top, S orb, greeting true to the time of day, quote — about 50% bigger, alive and moving, sweet spot judged by the eye. Day-nav buttons lifted clear of the frame; where-you-are top-right on every board, Back top-left, Keep reading dead centre. Cover slide removed; the day's chosen cover is the background behind the day's slides in the day's colour, never behind wisdom; the day opens on Wisdom, then Notifications. All of it rides the next calendar round after fix-11 lands. Behind it: filed means on the Hub straight away — the rebake chain restores instant; Hub finishes FIRST, all of today's edits, then the Personal mirror takes the finished Hub verbatim, titles Personal / Business / World; every return is verified by the captain and handed straight to him — verify, then hand over, nothing sits, nothing batches. Avatar motion: no further renders — the motion layer is not attaching, the fix is platform-side, verify motion only by his eye or ear on a call.
